source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Singles events draw players with many goals: showing hobby work, chasing Best General, meeting people or probing unusual rules interactions. When the Core Rules leave a rules question unclear, consult the Rules Appendix and the faction errata and FAQs in the official Warhammer 40,000 app.
